description: Get move details by name or numeric ID — type, damage class, power, accuracy, PP, priority, target, stat changes, status-effect chance, English effect text (the latest in-game description when PokéAPI has no effect text), and the TM, TR, or HM that teaches it in each version group. Set include_learners=true to include the list of Pokémon that can learn the move. Move names are available from pokeapi_get_pokemon when include_moves=true.

identifier.description: Move name (e.g. "flamethrower", "King’s Shield", "close-combat") or numeric ID as a string.

include_learners.description: Include the list of Pokémon that can learn this move. Defaults to false as the list can be large.

version_group.description: PokéAPI version-group name (e.g. "scarlet-violet"). Limits machine rows to this group.

name: pokeapi_get_move

accuracy.description: Accuracy percentage (1–100). Null for moves that never miss or skip the accuracy check, including where PokéAPI lists a placeholder accuracy of 0.

damageClass.description: Damage class: physical, special, or status. Null when unavailable.

effectChance.description: Secondary effect chance percentage. Null when not applicable.

effectText.description: PokéAPI's full English effect description. When it has none, the latest English in-game flavor text, folded to one line and named by effectTextVersionGroup. Null when neither exists.

effectTextVersionGroup.description: Version group whose in-game flavor text effectText carries. Null when effectText is PokéAPI's effect description or absent.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `not_found`: The identifier resolves to no move in PokéAPI. `invalid_version_group`: The supplied version_group is not a known PokéAPI version-group name. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

learnedByPokemon.description: Pokémon names that can learn this move (populated when include_learners=true).

learnersIncluded.description: True when the learner list was requested, including when no learners are known.

machines.description: One row per version group in upstream order. Empty when no machine teaches the move, or when version_group names a group without a row.

items.description: The machine that teaches this move in one version group.

item.description: TM, TR, or HM item (e.g. "tm149") that teaches the move in the version group. Null when its machine record could not be read; notices name the group.

versionGroup.description: Version group this machine row applies to.

notices.description: Notices about version-group selection and machine records that were not read.

power.description: Base power. Null when the move has no fixed base power (status moves and variable-power moves), including where PokéAPI lists a placeholder power of 0.

priority.description: Priority bracket (positive = higher priority, negative = lower).

shortEffectText.description: PokéAPI's short English effect summary. Null when unavailable, including whenever effectText is flavor text.

statChanges.description: Stat stage changes PokéAPI lists for this move. PokéAPI does not record whether they apply to the user or the target, or under what condition; see effectText for both.

items.description: Stat stage change entry — affected stat and magnitude.

change.description: Stat stage change (positive = buff, negative = debuff).

title: Get Move
